The '''''Suelu''''' was an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The cruiser was sent to capture up one of two [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier]]s [[Prowler (escort carriers)|''Prowler'']] that was disabled by two [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. The cruiser would come under attack from two pairs of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]], [[Sharky (corvette group)|''Sharky'']] and [[Spear (corvette group)|''Spear'']] followed by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]]. The attack was thwarted by the TIE Defenders and the cruiser boarded and captured the carrier. Both ships would then jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] as the Rebel [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Egale]]'' arrived.
